description: Add, move and shape objects with Python executed inside Blender.

identity.goal: Complete the build scene use case of blender using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the blender upstream of the blender-connector connector. The namespace `blender` is active by default; if the operator set lazy activation, activate it with registry_activate first. Every tool below is namespaced blender_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `blender_execute_blender_code`. Steps: (1) Plan the geometry change in bpy terms. (2) Execute it in one bounded code block. (3) Verify the result with the scene inventory or a look. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the blender namespace was available before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the upstream snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
